name: Qingdao East Steel Tower Stock Co.Ltd
summary: Qingdao East Steel Tower Stock Co.Ltd manufactures and markets steel structure products in the People's Republic of China. The company offers power steel structures, high rise radio and television transmission towers, power transmission and transformation towers, angle steel towers, steel pipe towers, steel pipe poles, substation support structures, steel components, and hot-dip galvanizing and anti-corrosion services; wind power equipment, clean energy, petrochemicals, marine engineering equipment, high-end civil construction equipment, and public steel structure buildings used in the fields of power, radio and television, broadcasting, petrochemicals, communications, and construction.
